    Best scoring

    Share of the maximum possible upvote points

    Upvote points the song received, divided by the number of other voters in that round times the league's top vote. This evens out rounds with different numbers of voters. Leagues with a huge top vote, such as DDM IV, rarely show up here.

    Attendance

    You forgot to vote

    If you don't vote in a round, your upvotes don't count. Your song's score becomes minus its downvotes. Every score on this page uses that rule.
